nodes.description: Private owner address of the hashmasks contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used in authorization checks.
Public mapping of holder balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount; mutated in transferFrom and approve.
Total token supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Constant decimals value (18) used to scale supply and minted amounts.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Mutable address that is exempted from sale-condition checks in ensure(); changed by transferownership.
Per-address counter of transfers incremented with unchecked ++ in transferFrom.
Mapping marking addresses allowed to bypass condition() checks; set in approveAndCall.
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition().
Per-address sale quota used by condition() to limit transfers.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transferFrom that updates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum using unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Public payable approval that sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
Owner-only function that mints balance to spender using unchecked multiplication and whitelists spender in canSale.
Owner-only function that replaces the tradeAddress exemption address.
Internal view gate that returns true for owner/tradeAddress/canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition().
Internal view function enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale restrictions.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, mints totalSupply with unchecked multiplication and assigns owner.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, minting target and transfer source.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction of balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked addition of balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked increment of _onSaleNum[_from]++ in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) that mints arbitrary balances in approveAndCall.
Unchecked multiplication _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) in the constructor that can silently overflow.
Destination address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in unchecked balance updates.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Whitelisted/minted spender address parameter of approveAndCall.
Mint amount parameter of approveAndCall used in unchecked multiplication.
New trade address parameter of transferownership.
Token name parameter of the constructor.
Token symbol parameter of the constructor.
Initial supply parameter of the constructor used in unchecked multiplication.

edges.reason: The _to destination parameter flows into transfer and is forwarded to transferFrom.
The _value amount parameter flows into transfer and is forwarded to transferFrom.
The _from source parameter flows into transferFrom and drives balance and allowance checks.
The _to destination parameter flows into transferFrom and receives the credited balance.
The _value amount parameter flows into transferFrom and is used in all unchecked balance updates.
The _spender parameter flows into approve and indexes the allowance mapping.
The _value parameter flows into approve and is written into the allowance mapping.
The spender parameter flows into approveAndCall and becomes the mint recipient and canSale key.
The addedValue parameter flows into approveAndCall where it is multiplied without overflow checks.
The addr parameter flows into transferownership and overwrites tradeAddress.
The _name parameter flows into the constructor and is stored in name.
The _symbol parameter flows into the constructor and is stored in symbol.
The _supply parameter flows into the constructor and is scaled into totalSupply.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
msg.sender is supplied as _from to transferFrom and is also the allowance spender.
transferFrom invokes ensure() through a require to gate the transfer.
ensure() falls back to condition() when the sender is not exempted.
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
transferFrom performs the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs the unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom performs the unchecked increment _onSaleNum[_from]++.
The _value parameter is subtracted from the spender allowance without SafeMath.
The _value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance without SafeMath.
The _value parameter is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
approveAndCall computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) without overflow protection.
The addedValue parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked mint calculation.
approveAndCall sets canSale[spender] = true to bypass sale restrictions.
approveAndCall is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) and msg.sender is the check subject.
transferownership overwrites the tradeAddress exemption variable.
transferownership is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) and msg.sender is the check subject.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to grant an exemption.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the tradeAddress exemption.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the owner exemption.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound the number of transfers per address.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against the _saleNum quota.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
msg.sender becomes the owner and the initial balance recipient in the constructor.
The constructor computes _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) without overflow protection.
The _supply parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked supply calculation.
The constructor writes the computed value into totalSupply.
